# Petso

> > Petso is Australia's premium online pet supply retailer specializing in smart pet care products, prescription nutrition, and eco-friendly supplies for cats and dogs.

Petso offers a curated selection of pet products from leading brands like PETKIT, PIDAN, and others, with a focus on innovative automatic feeders, self-cleaning litter boxes, and veterinary-approved nutrition. The site features detailed buying guides, product comparisons, and a VIPaw Rewards loyalty program for customers.

## Key Topics

- Automatic feeders and litter boxes
- Smart pet technology
- Prescription pet food
- Cat litter and odour control
- Pet furniture and accessories
- Flea and tick prevention
- Eco-friendly pet products
- PETKIT brand
- PIDAN brand
- Petso VIPaw Rewards
- Product comparisons
- Vet-approved supplies
- Cat care essentials

- Travel and carriers
